command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./data -prune -o -type f -print | head -50; ls -la data | head -50; cat docs/overview.md

cd /app/data; cat policy.ini branches.csv calendar.csv; head -5 patrons.csv waivers.csv; ls -la exports; cat exports/manifest* 2>/dev/null | head; for f in exports/*; do echo == $f; head -c 600 $f | head -4; done; cat /app/tools/check_fees.py | head -60; sed -n 1,60p /app/tests/test_fees.py

cd /app && python3 - <<'E'
p='bin/fees.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''r = {k: (v or "").strip() for k, v in r.items() if k is not None and isinstance(v, str) or k is not None}''','''r = {k.strip(): (v or "").strip() for k, v in r.items() if k is not None and not isinstance(v, list)}''')
s=s.replace('''            amounts = [w[2] for w in waivers
                       if w[0] == n and w[1] in (L["id"], "*")]
''','')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
mkdir -p out; python3 bin/fees.py data out/statements.json && python tools/check_fees.py; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15
